title: Lash-e-Akbar Utaraha Hain Hussain
body:
Lash-e-Akbar Utaraha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Ke Khuwaat Dikaraha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Ke Rahon Pe Aseoon Ke Charik (x2)
Karlo Roshan Se Araha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Jaga Raka Raha Hain Payshaane (x2)
Upne Kaaba Bana Raha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Larke Kara Hain Hey Umbia Key Qadam (x2)
Is Jaga Muskura Raha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Do Sada Ho Kahan Ali Akbar (x2)
Wo Kare Raan Me Khaarahain Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jahoo Qyame Me Jahoo Zainab (x2)
Lash-e-Akbar Dilaraha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aha Karate Hey Bhaatay Jahte Hain (x2)
Iska Laasha Utaraha Hain Hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chun Ke Qasim Key Laash Kay Tukaray (x2)
Upene Damman Me Laraha Hain Hussain.
